name: kokoro-webgpu-chrome-extension
description: Chrome Extension (Manifest V3) for local neural text-to-speech with Kokoro-82M and WebGPU acceleration.

scripts.package: rm -f dist/kokoro-ai-extension.zip && zip -r dist/kokoro-ai-extension.zip manifest.json icons src -x '*.DS_Store*' 'src/voices/zf_*' 'src/voices/zm_*' 'src/voices/jf_*' 'src/voices/jm_*' 'src/voices/hf_*' 'src/voices/hm_*' 'src/voices/if_*' 'src/voices/im_*' 'src/voices/pf_*' 'src/voices/pm_*' 'src/voices/ff_*'
scripts.test: node tests/test-buffer-management.js && node tests/test-mp3-download.js && node tests/test-persistence.js && node tests/test-karaoke-paragraphs.js && node tests/test-ui-reset-and-concurrency.js

author: 0utKast
